_note: Provenance for each corpus document. Attached to every chunk at ingestion so a citation carries its source, version and jurisdiction. Fields left null are not stated in the corpus text and must be filled from the authoritative instrument before any provenance claim is made. An entry is marked verified once its provenance and the provisions it records have been checked against the publisher's own text, and the version field names the instrument that was checked. Entries that remain unverified have not yet been through that check.
